notes: Cash basis (modified cash basis) school district, all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund on the statement; no business-type funds). Receipts, disbursements and transfers are the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5). Beginning cash is the governmental funds beginning fund balance (9,181,463, p5), which equals cash on the cash-basis statement. Balance sheet taken from the government-wide net position section (p3), which has no liabilities; the governmental funds balance sheet (p6) prints liabilities -0-. 'Support services - students' 1,746,626 split by fund column into General Fund 1,238,121 (support services) and Other Governmental Funds 508,505 (Activities Fund disbursements, p19; student activities). 'Other local receipts' 527,499 put in charges for services/fees because 503,727 of it (activities receipts 467,652 and nutrition other receipts 36,075) is from Other Governmental Funds; marked review. Statement's General Fund column consolidates the General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (GF schedule 10,114,117 receipts less 740 transfer in + Depreciation interest 34,406 + Employee Benefit interest 231 = 10,148,014). General Fund schedule transportation 637,194 includes a 250,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (statement shows 387,194); split as hidden transfer in detail, internal to the statement's General Fund column. Detail covers all fund budget schedules (pp7-19); the Special Building, Student Fee, Cooperative and Depreciation disbursement lines or blank-actual lines (e.g. Employee Benefit benefits paid, Bond refunded) have no 2025 actual and are omitted; budget-only lines omitted. Activities Fund 'General Fund support' 30,000 and nutrition 'Transfers in' 101,936 plus GF 131,936 transfers out tie to statement transfers 132,676 (with Cooperative Fund 740 transfer to General Fund). Component unit (Ord Public School Foundation) excluded. Read pages 1-19 of 19
